description: [PAID $0.005 USDC per call via x402] Before your agent signs an EVM transaction: simulates it on the current chain state and reports every token and native-coin movement in and out of the sender, decodes what it asks for (ERC-20 approve/permit, Permit2, setApprovalForAll, transfers), checks the counterparty (contract or wallet, sanctions lists) and, if you pass expectedTo, flags look-alike addresses (address poisoning). Verdict: "danger", "caution" or "no_known_risk", with every reason. It never says "safe": a simulation shows what would happen at this block. Chains: eip155:8453, eip155:1, eip155:137, eip155:42161, eip155:10, eip155:43114, eip155:1329, eip155:130, eip155:146, eip155:480, eip155:5042, eip155:999. Priced by the USD value at risk you declare in valueUsd: under $1,000: $0.005; under $10,000: $0.05; under $100,000: $0.50 (deep review); $100k and up: $2.00 (deep review). Deep review adds a second simulation on an independent provider and a counterparty check of every address involved.

chain.description: CAIP-2 EVM chain id, e.g. eip155:8453

data.description: calldata, 0x... (omit for a plain native transfer)

expectedTo.description: the recipient or contract you MEANT to interact with; enables the look-alike check

valueUsd.description: approximate USD value at risk; sets the price tier, and $10,000+ includes the deep review

name: tx_safety_check
title: Is this transaction safe to sign? (simulate + risk check)
